meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: A replica of the DeepSeek chat UI (modelled on the web app at chat.deepseek.com): a sidebar entry and a full-screen chat panel with DeepThink, smart search, link reading, file input, voice input, and read-aloud. It uses deepseek-flash, keeps the API key in this machine's credentials, and proxies every request through the Host.
